answer: Work slots stop sybil farming: to claim one slot per epoch, an agent burns 50 POA, lost either way. The delta: one honest agent pays 50 once and earns about 200, while 1,000 fake identities must burn 50,000 POA for slots that earn nothing. Each slot is a pearl: one burn, one pearl; a thousand pearls need a thousand burns. A random audit sweeps the slots, falcon-fast, and copied work loses its payout, so bought accounts only buy more burns.
